notes.title: Updates and new game release!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!

Our latest game Mai: Child of Ages has just been released, check out the game page!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages"][/dynamiclink]

Venture through past and future, exploring Zelda-like dungeons, and uncover the bond that ties Mai to the enigmatic figure who will guide her throughout the adventure, teaching her the mastery of the arcane Uroboro Stone.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29702066/72b53e05a8f0fba9bcdf978c219956ba25e42715.jpg"]

Also new updates for Suicide Guy 2 are coming, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams release is next month!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
The new chapter of Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams is coming next month, stay tuned for the full release!
Add to your wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423470/Suicide_Guy_The_Lost_Dreams/

Features:

· 18 levels set inside Suicide Guy's dream worlds

· Physics based puzzles

· Vehicles to drive

· Bizarre creatures that you will interact with during your adventure

· Crazy Skills: be able to pick up items, throw them, utilize dreamworld tools and even burp.

· Many Collectible items to find

To celebrate we're releasing a new Update 1.60 for Suicide Guy on Steam with a 60% Sale. :suicideguy:

This is thanks to all your support, helping the game to reach 40.000 copies sold on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/303610/Suicide_Guy/

- Improved physics interactions with the items
- Better and more refined graphics
- Higher FPS and faster loading times
- bugs and glitches fixes

I hope you'll appreciate!
Expect more content to be released soon for the game.

MalboM
